the reason i went with the z97 motherboard was because it was the cheapest motherboard i could find which has the basic features compared to another b85 motherboard which was only £5 cheaper. if you look for another atx motherboard with the basic features you will find nearly the same price as this z97 motherboard. this one also allows for crossfire, which is good, and dual gpu setups are a large reason why you would consider going for atx pc's compared to smaller ones. tbh, there are other motherboards with similar features and cost around £20 cheaper, but this motherboard has much more features for future upgradeability and a major one is crossfire. i don't think you would very much consider an atx pc over a mitx or matx one if it wasn't for the upgradeability. please say otherwise if you have to.

the reason i chose this psu was because, compared to other psu's in its price range, i'm pretty sure this eats them. 600w is a minimum you would want with the 4460 and r9 390. other psu's which were 600w+ and were bronze 80+ rated which is the minimum you want from a psu in this build cost around £4±, but this has 50w more watts, is gold rated and is quiet more reliable. if you want modularity, you would want to invest ore money as modular psu's would exceed the budget im pretty sure.
